description: Catalog of real-world app forks used to smoke-test vite-plus pre-releases. Source of truth for tooling and the release-manager skill.

fields.name: fork repo name under the org
fields.branch: the branch to test (often NOT the fork default branch)
fields.packageManager: pnpm | npm | yarn | bun | node (no committed lockfile) | other (non-JS)
fields.notes: free-form (e.g. CI runs on push only, special setup)

repos.name: anywidget
repos.notes: `JavaScript / Test` runs `vp dlx playwright install`, which installs the latest Playwright browsers rather than the version the project pins, so the browser executable is missing. Not caused by vite-plus.

repos.name: arrow-hero
repos.notes: Small browser game on vite-plus 1.1.0 with Yarn 4 (`nodeLinker: node-modules`). Scripts run `vp dev`, `vp build`, and `vp preview`. The only workflow, `cd.yml`, runs `vp check` and `vp build` through `setup-vp` on push to `master` and deploys GitHub Pages, so test PRs get no CI; validate locally.

repos.name: better-ajv-errors
repos.notes: Atlassian JSON schema error formatter on vite-plus 1.1.0 through the catalog, which also pins `vitest` 5.0.3 and the `@vitest/*` packages, so update those with the preview build. Scripts run `vp pack`, `vp fmt --check`, `vp lint`, and `vp test --coverage`. `main.yml` runs `test` and `lint` jobs on `pull_request` without secrets (Codecov upload is optional). `release.yml` only runs on the upstream repository.

repos.name: bippy
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork, so its check fails with `Check failed (404): The app https://github.com/apps/pkg-pr-new is not installed`. Unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package". `e2e-web` (Playwright) fails in recent cycles (not investigated). Its HMR spec runs `vite/bin/vite.js`, which the core alias does not have; use `vite-plus/bin/vp dev`. The `@refresh reset` HMR test fails on Vite 8 because its Oxc refresh transform drops the flag (same on v1.1.0).

repos.name: brazilian-utils-javascript
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the `Test on Deno` job fails on `expect(...).toHaveBeenCalledTimes is not a function`, a Deno test-environment issue independent of the vite-plus version. `vp migrate` stops on the Vitest v5 `benchmark-api` block (bench references need manual migration), on v1.0.0 too.

repos.name: cloudflare-cf
repos.notes: Cloudflare `cf` CLI (pnpm 12 workspace) on vite-plus 1.1.0 through the catalog. Scripts run `vp run` tasks and `vp lint --type-aware`. `ci.yml` runs `check`, `cli` (ubuntu, macOS, windows), and `wrangler-tests` on `pull_request` without secrets; `prerelease.yml` and `roboreview-pr-review.yml` need secrets. `blockExoticSubdeps: true` and `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` without an explicit `minimumReleaseAge`, so pnpm's default gate applies.

repos.name: cloudflare-os
repos.notes: `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `minimumReleaseAge: 1440` and its exclude list omits vite-plus, so add `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*` to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` on the test branch. That gate keys off publish time, so it also rejects a real release on release day. Gate `preview.yml`, `bonk*.yml`, and `cla.yml`, which need credentials the fork lacks. `Build and test` runs `pnpm exec vite build`, which fails after migration because the `vite` alias to vite-plus-core has no bin. `CLAssistant` and `bonk` fail on the fork. Migrate's oxfmt reformat joins multi-line string concatenations, which trips `no-useless-concat`. The catalog pins a real `vite` (7.3.6) next to vite-plus, and `build-app.ts` runs the `vite` binary; restore that pin on the test branch after migrate. `CLAssistant` and `bonk` run via `pull_request_target` or third-party setup and cannot pass on the fork. A test asserts that `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `.npmrc` use only registry.npmjs.org, which a preview build cannot satisfy.

repos.name: codiff
repos.notes: CI triggers on push only; PRs do not run CI unless the workflow adds a pull_request trigger

repos.name: Cookies-EU-banner
repos.notes: Uses vp pack, vp test, and vp check. The pnpm version is declared in devEngines.packageManager. Its CI runs on pull_request: vp run build, vp check, and Playwright browser tests on Ubuntu.

repos.name: crust
repos.notes: Crust CLI framework (pnpm 12 workspace) on vite-plus 1.0.0 through the catalog. Scripts run `vp run`, `vp lint`, and `vp fmt --check`. Several path-filtered `pull_request` workflows (`ci-packages.yml`, `ci-docs.yml`, `ci-tooling.yml`, `ci-create-crust.yml`, `type-perf.yml`) run `vp run` and `vp test` without secrets; an upgrade commit touching `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` triggers most of them.

repos.name: css-modules-kit
repos.notes: `minimumReleaseAge: 4320`. Add `@oxc-project/*` to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` when Vite+ pins freshly published oxc packages; migrate adds the other Vite+ packages itself.

repos.name: delta-comic
repos.notes: CI triggers on push only; PRs do not run CI unless the workflow adds a pull_request trigger

repos.name: docx-editor
repos.notes: SuperDoc DOCX editor (large pnpm 11 workspace). The catalog still pins vite-plus 0.2.7, `vite` to vite-plus-core 0.2.7, and `vitest` 4.1.10, and overrides keep plain `vite` at `^7.2.7` for packages outside Vite+, so migrate exercises a 0.x upgrade with a split `vite`. Scripts run `vp test` and `vp fmt`. `validate.yml` and the path-filtered package workflows run on `pull_request` without secrets; `cla.yml` and `label-prs.yml` need secrets.

repos.name: dotabod-backend
repos.notes: fork-CI noise is limited to jobs the fork cannot run: the `build (*)` Docker image jobs need registry credentials (`Password required`) and `format` needs a token (`Input required and not supplied: token`). The `test` job is the real signal and does pass; if it fails with `Cannot find native binding`, that is the bridge flake, so re-run it. Did not use vite-plus before migration. Package `build` scripts run `vp pack --config ../../tsdown.config.ts`, which treats the config path as an entry and fails in the dts plugin (identical on v1.0.0). `vp migrate` keeps `tsdown --config <file>` as `vp pack --config <file>`, which vp pack does not support (the path becomes an entry); drop the option. Point `fmt` at `oxfmt.config.ts` and run `vp fmt` without `--config`. Rebuild the oxlint baseline after building the workspace packages, because type-aware diagnostics differ without their types.

repos.name: dotabod-frontend
repos.notes: Did not use vite-plus before migration. `vp migrate` ignores the project's `oxfmt.config.ts` and writes `fmt: {}`; point `fmt` at that config before formatting. The lint step is an oxlint baseline ratchet that pins `oxlintVersion`, so re-bootstrap the baseline with the project's `--bootstrap` flow after each oxlint bump. Register `oxlint.deno.config.ts` as a knip entry after migration. Rebuild the oxlint baseline (`OXLINT_BASELINE_BOOTSTRAP=1 node tools/quality/verify-oxlint-baseline.ts --bootstrap` after removing the old file) and format it whenever oxlint or oxlint-tsgolint changes.

repos.name: electron-vite-template
repos.notes: Electron template (pnpm 11 workspace) with `vite-plus ^1.1.0` in the root `package.json`; builds run `vp run --cache desktop#build` before electron-builder, and the shared config lives in `tools/build/configs/vite.config.mts`. `Build.yml` runs install and `pnpm run build` on `pull_request` on `windows-latest` without secrets. `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` without an explicit `minimumReleaseAge`, so pnpm 11's default gate applies.

repos.name: elysia-clerk
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork; its check fails with a 404. Unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: evcc
repos.notes: evcc. Go backend with a Vue frontend; only the frontend uses vite-plus (`vp dev`, `vp fmt`, `vp lint`). No committed packageManager field. `default.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. No supply-chain gate in `.npmrc`. Workflows target `depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm` and `depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm-32`; map both to `ubuntu-24.04-arm`. Locally, Node 22.18's npm 10 fails on the `storybook` override `"vite-plus": "$vite-plus"` with a preview build; regenerate the lockfile with npm 11 or later. Migrate's final install runs the bundled npm 10.9, which cannot resolve the `$vite-plus` override, so regenerate `package-lock.json` with npm 11 on the test branch. `PR labeling` runs via `pull_request_target` and needs an Anthropic secret.

repos.name: fate
repos.notes: project-side: `example/server-graphql/scripts/generate-graphql.tsx` imports `oxfmt` without declaring it, so it only resolves through hoisting. Fails with `Cannot find package 'oxfmt'` whenever the lockfile is regenerated. Unrelated to vite-plus. `vp migrate` stops on the Vitest v5 `benchmark-api` block (a bench call needs manual migration), on v1.0.0 too.

repos.name: freecut
repos.notes: Vitest 5 type-checking needs `import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest'` in `src/test/setup.ts`; the default jest-dom entry leaves about 1200 `TS2339` errors in `vp check`.

repos.name: graph-explorer
repos.notes: AWS Graph Explorer, on vite-plus 1.1.0 through the catalog, so a sweep exercises a real upgrade. Scripts run `vp config`, `vp lint`, `vp fmt`, and `vp test run`. `ci.yml` runs one `checks-and-tests` job on `pull_request` without secrets. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `minimumReleaseAge: 1440` and `trustPolicy: no-downgrade`, so exempt the preview build (`vite-plus`, `@voidzero-dev/*`) and freshly pinned toolchain packages on the test branch. `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict=true`.

repos.name: hono
repos.notes: Hono web framework (pnpm 12 workspace, `.` and `adapters/*`) with vite-plus 1.0.0 and `vitest` 5.0.1 as root devDependencies. Scripts run `vp test` (node, workerd, fastly projects), `vp check`, and `vp lint`. `ci.yml` and `ci-adapters.yml` run on `pull_request` without secrets, including Bun and Deno jobs and a Windows Bun job; `cr.yml` only publishes on the upstream repository.

repos.name: jaeger-ui
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the `check-label` job requires every PR to carry a `changelog:***` label, so ecosystem-ci test PRs always fail it. The `lint-build` job also runs project meta-checks (`knip`, `check-overrides`) that fail whenever dependencies change. Unrelated to vite-plus. With a preview build, `check-overrides` reports a phantom `vite@*` override because the prerelease version does not match `*`; a real release does not.

repos.name: kaneo
repos.notes: Kaneo project management app (pnpm 10 workspace, `onlyBuiltDependencies`) on vite-plus 1.0.0 through the catalog, with `vitest` 5.0.3. Scripts run `vp run -r`, `vp check`, and `vp fmt`. Every CI job runs on Blacksmith runners (`blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404`) that the fork does not have, so test PRs get no checks; validate locally.

repos.name: koel
repos.notes: pinned to a very old vite-plus (0.1.x) and still using the removed `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-test` alias, so `vp migrate` performs a multi-release jump. Resulting TypeScript errors are not evidence about the release under test. Re-pin before using it as an upgrade signal.

repos.name: local-studio
repos.notes: Local Studio, a pnpm 11 monorepo (`apps/*`, `packages/*`) on vite-plus 1.0.0 through the catalog; scripts drive builds with `vp run --filter`. `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets on GitHub-hosted runners (`ubuntu-latest`, `macos-15`); `release.yml` needs Apple signing secrets and runs only on push and dispatch. `prepare` runs `effect-tsgo patch`, so like sigle it needs an `@effect/tsgo` release that supports the bundled oxlint and oxlint-tsgolint versions. `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` exists without an explicit `minimumReleaseAge`, so pnpm 11 applies its default gate; extend the list for fresh toolchain packages on the test branch.

repos.name: matterviz
repos.notes: `vite.config.ts` now imports `svelte-widgets/vite-config`, so the earlier `@janosh/vite-config` blocker no longer applies. The base branch commits no lockfile. Its CI setup action installs each `extensions/*` package with `pnpm install --no-lockfile` in a standalone workspace, which cannot resolve the `catalog:` specs that migrate writes (`ERR_PNPM_CATALOG_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND_FOR_SPEC`), so every job fails at install. Its setup action recreates `pnpm-workspace.yaml` with `>`, which deletes the catalog `vp migrate` writes; append with `>>` on the test branch. Drop the `pnpm-lock.yaml` that migrate generates.

repos.name: mcp-omnisearch
repos.notes: preview-build limitation: the Docker build context does not carry the bridge `.npmrc`, so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` inside the image rejects the commit-build tarball URLs with `ERR_PNPM_TARBALL_URL_MISMATCH`. Cannot happen for a real npm release. `minimumReleaseAge: 2880`; add `@oxc-project/*` to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` when Vite+ pins freshly published oxc packages.

repos.name: media-processors
repos.notes: project-side: a package imports `esbuild` without declaring it and only resolves it through hoisting, so it fails with `Cannot find package 'esbuild'` whenever the lockfile is regenerated. Unrelated to vite-plus.

repos.name: museeks
repos.notes: project-side: `@stylexjs/unplugin` wants `unplugin ^2` while the repo installs 3.x. A regenerated lockfile makes this fatal under `strictPeerDependencies: true`; set it to false on the test branch. `binaries (macos-14)` fails at codesigning because the fork has no signing secrets.

repos.name: npmx.dev
repos.notes: The org copy is a detached fork (no GitHub parent), so `gh repo fork` cannot re-link it; the `source` remote must be added by hand. `Component tests` has failed since the 1.0.0-rc.1 cycle: 45 a11y tests reject a `@vue/compiler-core` `decodeEntities` warning in Vitest 5 browser mode. See why-reproductions-are-required/vitest-vue-compiler-decode-entities. CI installs through Socket Firewall (`sfw: true` in setup-vp); with a preview build the package-manager download from the bridge `.npmrc` fails with `UnknownIssuer` (voidzero-dev/vite-plus#3031), so set `sfw: false` on the test branch. `.github/zizmor.yml` ignores a finding by line number in `lunaria.yml`, so keep that `uses:` line where it is.

repos.name: nshipster.com
repos.notes: NSHipster site (Astro, npm with `package-lock.json`) still on `vite-plus ^0.3.3`, so migrate exercises a 0.x to 1.x upgrade. No package scripts call vp; `ci.yml` runs `npx vp test --project browser --project site` on `pull_request` without secrets.

repos.name: ohbug
repos.notes: project-side: `@ohbug/unplugin`'s webpack entry pulls webpack/tapable and postcss CommonJS `.d.ts` files that rolldown-plugin-dts cannot bundle, so its `postinstall` build fails. Set `pack.dts: false` for that package on the test branch. Reproduces on older vite-plus releases.

repos.name: OneSignal-Website-SDK
repos.notes: Vitest 5.0.3's `spyOn` overload makes two `@ts-expect-error` comments in `src/page/bell/Bell.test.ts` unused (`TS2578`); remove them on the test branch.

repos.name: orval
repos.notes: Orval. Deepest `vp run` usage in the catalog (19 scripts) and one of the few bun projects. `pr-checks.yaml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. `bunfig.toml` sets `minimumReleaseAge = 259200`, so bun rejects any fresh publish; set it to `0` on the test branch, because bun's `minimumReleaseAgeExcludes` does not accept the `@voidzero-dev/*` glob.

repos.name: oxc-walker
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `trustPolicy: no-downgrade`, which rejects bridge preview builds because they carry no provenance. Add `trustPolicyExclude` for `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*` on the test branch.

repos.name: oxlint-tailwindcss
repos.notes: Oxlint plugin for Tailwind CSS. The pnpm workspace (`packages/*`) uses oxlint and oxfmt directly, not vite-plus. vite-plus 1.1.0 only appears in `bench/`, a standalone npm project (`bench/package-lock.json`) whose `vite-plus.mjs` checks the plugin under `vp lint`; `bench.yml` runs it on a schedule. PR CI (`ci.yml`) lints, builds, and tests the plugin without vp, so the smoke test mostly exercises the bench and `vp migrate` on the workspace.

repos.name: pdfme
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `.npmrc` sets `min-release-age=3`, so npm rejects a fresh publish with `ETARGET`. Set `min-release-age=0` on the test branch.

repos.name: pocket-id
repos.notes: Pocket ID OIDC provider: Go backend plus a pnpm 11 workspace (`frontend`, `tests`) on vite-plus 1.0.0 through the catalog. Scripts run `vp -C frontend` and `vp check`. In `ci.yml`, the vp jobs (`svelte-check`, Playwright e2e) and backend jobs run on Depot runners (`depot-ubuntu-*`) that the fork does not have, so they never start; validate locally.

repos.name: raindrop-mcp
repos.notes: Raindrop.io MCP server, a bun project on vite-plus 1.1.0 (direct pin plus the `vite` core alias). Scripts run `vp check`, `vp lint`, `vp fmt`, and `vp test run`. `publish.yml` runs its `test` job (lint, format check, type-check, build, unit and MCP integration tests) on `pull_request` with only `GITHUB_TOKEN`; the `release` job runs only on pushes to `master`, so nothing needs gating. One workspace: `tooling/compiler-api`.

repos.name: rari
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` rejects bridge preview builds, and also `cytoscape` as a pnpm cross-major false positive (pnpm/pnpm#10202). Add both to `trustPolicyExclude` on the test branch. Workflows target `namespace-profile-rari-linux-amd64` and `namespace-profile-rari-windows-amd64` (map to `ubuntu-latest` and `windows-latest`) and use `namespacelabs/nscloud-checkout-action` (replace with `actions/checkout`). `Run benchmarks` needs a CodSpeed token. `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` also needs `vite-plus`, `@voidzero-dev/*`, and `@oxc-project/*` when Vite+ pins fresh oxc packages. Its CI uses Namespace cache and artifact actions that need a Namespace volume; replace them with GitHub's cache and artifact actions on the test branch, and gate the CodSpeed upload.

repos.name: react-data-grid
repos.notes: React data grid on npm (`package-lock.json`, no `packageManager` field) with vite-plus 1.1.0, `vite` aliased to vite-plus-core 1.1.0, and `vitest` 5.0.3 as direct devDependencies. `ci.yml` runs `vp install --frozen-lockfile` and `vp run -v ci` through `setup-vp` on `pull_request`; the Codecov upload uses `secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN`, and `deploy` only runs on push.

repos.name: react-hookz-web
repos.notes: The only yarn project in the catalog (yarn 4.x), so it is the sole cover for yarn install and migrate paths. The org fork is named `react-hookz-web`, because `web` is ambiguous. `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` and its only secret is `CODECOV_TOKEN`; that upload failure counts as passing. No supply-chain gate. Yarn's age gate rejects freshly pinned toolchain packages; extend `npmPreapprovedPackages` with `@oxc-project/*`, `oxlint`, `oxfmt`, and their scopes on the test branch.

repos.name: react-useanimations
repos.notes: React animated icon library on vite-plus 1.1.0, with an npm workspace for `website`. Scripts run `vp pack`, `vp check`, and `vp test run`. `ci.yml` runs the `test` matrix (React versions, Playwright browsers) on `pull_request` without secrets. Its `preview` job runs for same-repository PRs and deploys to Netlify with `secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN`, so it fails on the fork; judge the run by the `test` jobs.

repos.name: redis-me
repos.notes: no pull_request-triggered workflow of its own (only `release.yml` on tags), so a test PR reports "no checks". Add `.github/workflows/ecosystem-ci-build.yml` running `vp check` and `vp build` on the test branch each release; see "Forks with no PR CI". Also needs `@types/node` and `"node"` in the tsconfig `types` array, because `vite.config.ts` uses `path`, `process`, and `import.meta.dirname` and `vp check` fails without them. Drop the added workflow once the repo runs these checks on pull requests itself.

repos.name: saasyland.com
repos.notes: Astro and Cloudflare site on Bun with `vite-plus ^1.0.0-rc.0` and `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core ^1.0.0-rc.0` as direct dependencies. Scripts run `vp check`, `vp dev`, and `vp staged`. `ci.yml` runs `verify` (check, test coverage) on `pull_request`; its `deploy-preview` job inherits Cloudflare secrets and fails on the fork.

repos.name: sandbox-sdk
repos.notes: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK (npm workspaces `packages/*`, `examples/*`; also a Cargo workspace). Still on vite-plus 0.3.3, so migrate exercises a 0.x to 1.x upgrade. Scripts run `vp pack`, `vp check`, and `vp test`. `pr.yml` runs `typescript`, `examples`, and `shim` jobs on `pull_request` without secrets; `pr-privileged.yml` (`pull_request_target`) needs Cloudflare and app secrets and fails on the fork.

repos.name: sigle
repos.notes: `prepare` runs `@effect/tsgo`, which refuses oxlint binding and oxlint-tsgolint versions it does not list (`UnsupportedTargetPackageVersionError`). Bump `@effect/tsgo` with each oxlint or tsgolint upgrade, exempt it from the 1-day `minimumReleaseAge` when it is fresh, and turn off its new non-recommended rules the way the project disables others. If no `@effect/tsgo` release lists the bundled versions yet, the project cannot upgrade.

repos.name: soybean-admin
repos.notes: Vue admin template, the parent of `soybean-admin-antd` with the same setup: catalog `vite-plus: latest`, scripts run `vp dev`, `vp build`, `vp fmt`, `vp lint`, and `vp config`, and `.npmrc` points at registry.npmmirror.com. No PR workflow runs vp (`linter.yml` is super-linter, `pr-agent.yml` needs `secrets.OPENAI_KEY`), so validate locally. `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` without an explicit `minimumReleaseAge`, so pnpm's default gate applies.

repos.name: soybean-admin-antd
repos.notes: Vue admin template (pnpm 12 workspace, `packages/*`). The catalog pins `vite-plus: latest` and `vite: npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@latest`; scripts run `vp dev`, `vp build`, `vp fmt`, `vp lint`, and `vp config`. `.npmrc` points at registry.npmmirror.com. No PR workflow runs vp: `linter.yml` runs super-linter and `pr-agent.yml` needs `secrets.OPENAI_KEY`, so validate locally with `vp build` and `vp lint`. `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` exists without an explicit `minimumReleaseAge`, so pnpm's default gate applies.

repos.name: spark-ui
repos.notes: Vue component registry on Bun, default branch `dev`. The Bun workspace catalog still pins vite-plus 0.2.5, `vite` to vite-plus-core 0.2.5, and `vitest` to `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-test` 0.1.24, so migrate exercises an early 0.x upgrade including the removed test package. Scripts run `vp lint` and `vp test run`. `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets, with tests on ubuntu, windows, and macOS.

repos.name: svelte-meta-tags
repos.notes: Svelte SEO meta tags library (pnpm 12 workspace) on vite-plus 1.0.0 through the catalog. Scripts run `vp run -r`, `vp check`, and `vp fmt`. `ci.yml` runs through `setup-vp` on `pull_request` without secrets. `minimumReleaseAge: 4320`, so exempt the preview build and freshly pinned toolchain packages on the test branch.

repos.name: svelte-multiselect
repos.notes: `vite.config.ts` now imports a local `src/lib/vite-config.ts`, so the earlier `@janosh/vite-config` blocker no longer applies; CI check, build, unit, and e2e pass. The base branch commits no lockfile, so never commit one. Locally, Node 22.18's bundled npm 10 cannot resolve the `"svelte": "$svelte"` override (`Unable to resolve reference $svelte`); CI uses Node 24 and npm 11. Commits no lockfile and declares no package manager, so the harness installs with pnpm. Generate an untracked `package-lock.json` with npm before migrating (add it to `.git/info/exclude`) so vp migrates the project as npm.

repos.name: sveltekit-embed
repos.notes: SvelteKit embed components (pnpm 12 workspace, `apps/*` and `packages/*`). The catalog pins vite-plus 1.1.0 with `vitest` 5.0.3 and `@vitest/*` 5.0.3, so update those with the preview build. Scripts run `vp check` and `vp build`. `unit-test.yml` runs build, check, and `test:ci` on `pull_request` targeting `main`; it reads the optional `PUBLIC_FATHOM_*` secrets as env. `minimumReleaseAge: 2880` and `.npmrc` `engine-strict=true` (Node >= 24.15.0).

repos.name: trpc-nuxt
repos.notes: On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: unplugin-turbo-console
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork; its check fails with a 404. Unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: urllib
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the CodSpeedHQ/action step fails on the fork (installer hash pin mismatch and `401 Unauthorized` on upload) because the fork has no CodSpeed token. Its CI also installs behind Socket Firewall (`sfw vp install`), which cannot reach `registry-bridge.viteplus.dev` and fails with `ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH_FAIL`; the bridge itself is healthy, and a real npm release resolves from registry.npmjs.org. Both are unrelated to vite-plus. `vp dedupe --check` fails after migrate regenerates the lockfile.

repos.name: v-offline
repos.notes: `Validate branch name` requires `type/name` branches, so push the test branch as `test/vite-plus-prerelease-<sha>` and open the PR from it. The `Vue Doctor` job then runs and fails to load `unplugin-vue/rolldown` from `vite.config.ts` (not yet investigated).

repos.name: varlet
repos.notes: On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: vean-ui
repos.notes: Vue UI library (pnpm 12 workspace). Catalog `vite-plus: latest`, with an override pinning `vitest` to 5.0.0; every package runs vp through its own `vite.config.ts`. `ci.yml` runs build, typecheck, `vp lint`, tests, and size checks on `pull_request` without secrets; `pr-agent.yml` needs `secrets.OPENAI_KEY`. `minimumReleaseAge: 0`.

repos.name: video.js
